name: Honu
description:
About This Game

Honu is a first-person 3D puzzle adventure set in a world where magic and technology come together.

As an explorer stepping through a portal, you find yourself on the untouched island of Honu, a place where nature has reclaimed the ruins of an ancient civilization. Strange magitech devices lie dormant among moss-covered stones, waiting to be understood once more.

Travel through a variety of biomes, from lush forests to ancient ruins. Unravel the island’s secrets by solving magitech puzzles that challenge your logic and creativity. Piece by piece, you’ll uncover the story of the people who once blended magic and technology to shape their world, and learn why they vanished.

Honu offers a story-driven experience full of mystery, exploration, and wonder, inviting you to think, experiment, and shape the world with the power of magitech.



Features:

  • Thoughtful puzzles – Repair, activate, and understand ancient magitech left behind by a lost civilization.

  • A living world – Explore a vibrant island filled with ruins, puzzles, and traces of old magic.

  • Meaningful encounters – Engage in quiet, heartfelt dialogue with the island’s inhabitants.

  • A journey of discovery – Follow your curiosity through a story about wonder, memory, and renewal.
short_desc: Honu is a first-person 3D puzzle adventure where magic meets technology. Solve logic-based puzzles, reshape the world with magitech, and uncover a story set in a mysterious, beautifully stylized world.
